input: Write a short thank-you speech for the award ceremony

gold.taskTitle: Write a Thank-You Speech for Award Ceremony
gold.taskDescription: Write a short thank-you speech to be delivered at an award ceremony.

questions.title: What specific award are you being recognized for?
questions.description: Understand the nature and name of the award to tailor the speech appropriately.

questions.title: Who is the audience at this ceremony?
questions.description: Identify the audience (colleagues, industry professionals, academics, community members, etc.) to match tone and language.

questions.title: How long should the speech be in minutes?
questions.description: Determine the target duration to guide the word count and depth of the speech.

questions.title: Which specific people or groups must you thank?
questions.description: Gather the names or roles of individuals, teams, or organizations that must be acknowledged.

questions.title: What tone should the speech carry overall?
questions.description: Clarify whether the speech should be formal, warm and personal, humorous, inspirational, or a mix.

questions.title: Is there a personal story or moment you want included?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a specific anecdote or personal detail woven into the speech.

questions.title: When exactly is the ceremony taking place?
questions.description: Establish the deadline so the writing timeline can be planned accordingly.
